# AI in Finance Daily — 2026-08-03

*A star AI hedge fund blows up on leverage, the EU AI Act gets teeth, and AI ETFs quietly eat a fifth of US volume.*

## 🔎 The lead

**The AI trade just claimed its highest-profile casualty.** Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness fund — run by the former OpenAI researcher dubbed the "Nostradamus of AI" — cratered roughly **67% in July** on leveraged AI bets [42](https://news.google.?oc=5) [29](https://news.google.?oc=5), and Citadel's Ken Griffin stepped in to buy most of its stock portfolio after a forced unwind [28](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQa0YzMXpNa3JiOUxWZm1XWFR0NFdvYWUwcEhIb2N1SFRxOHpodjVoN0hKRVMxSUxqc3VoRnB0Y2RwN3VqRlhsSWJid2hrUjdRcl9QaFpVeXR3d1dqdjU1bXUtMllMcUE3cFdqSVJqZVpCVDdzT3FDVnh5czhjRnRKb1JFYzBzaTl6SzdhMHMzdGFFMlQ3TzJid2tCemxrZw?oc=5) [22](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPb09TRG9hMWpZSzlBejI1SzZDS29Yd1hxUFRsN204QktRM2ZDNmMtSTBkcEFuM2JTX0NZbDRLT3pnalc3WkJibTNKSWtsZ1dvdGwzSDM1cUIxd3ZOSlJodWF5RXlvdmhNanFabmlYY3RLd1VrLXRKelNKSEVDemVIY1lPNmc2VGhKZllZNVU1S1pKTU43RWl3SFh3Yk9nT0hhd01JQnhqaVlkd1hOTjVzNC1yUQ?oc=5). He was *right about AI and wrong about leverage*, as CNBC TV18 put it [85](https://news.google.?oc=5). **So what:** the blowup is a clean morality tale for allocators — concentrated AI conviction plus leverage is a portfolio-ending combination, and it lands exactly as the broader AI trade wobbles. Expect LPs to interrogate leverage and single-theme exposure across every "AI-native" fund this quarter.
